concept.title: Concept
concept.tagline: A tool for your career and skill growth that grows together with you, instead of asking you to fill out a static profile once.
concept.motivation: Your career history keeps ending up on someone else's platform — a recruiter's site during a job search, your employer's internal system the rest of the time. That data was never really yours, and when you leave, it stays behind. What's actually left in your own hands, if anything, is a handful of scattered Word and Excel files. skillgrowth exists to fix that: a career record that lives on your own server, built on your own initiative, independent of whichever company happens to be holding your data this year.
concept.loopVision: Sketch out, even roughly, the kind of career you want to build — in Vision or on the Dashboard
concept.loopSkillTrack: Keep recording and updating the skills and activity you actually have
concept.loopRecord: Record your education, work history, and projects — at work or in the open (OSS)
concept.loopReflect: Reflect: on Self Feedback, look back at what you did and what's still missing
concept.loopPrepare: Prepare to take the next step in your career (resume/rirekisho generation, a job-posting gap check, growth guidance toward your goals). Only the job-posting gap check, growth guidance, and Career Consult (on AI Career Support) call an LLM here, and haven't been thoroughly vetted yet, so their reliability isn't guaranteed. Resume and rirekisho generation are deterministic, no LLM involved, and aren't covered by that caveat
concept.loopBranchLabel: 4 back to 1 is the main flow. It occasionally detours through 5 first
concept.loopNote: The main flow is 4 back to 1: reflecting on Self Feedback leads straight back into recording more activity and skills. Every so often it detours through step 5 instead — resume/rirekisho generation, a job-posting gap check, growth guidance toward your goals — before circling back to 1. Many of this app's screens — Dashboard, Profile, Activity, Skills, Certifications — are different views onto that same append-only activity log. Vision, career path goals, Self Feedback, Self PR, and resume/rirekisho generation itself all sit outside that log, though, and never go through LLM extraction at any point. Portfolio is outside it too — its description is deliberately excluded from skill extraction. Skill Network isn't another view onto the log either — it's a visualization of how skills relate to the other entities that back them.
concept.selfHostedBody: No accounts, no multi-tenancy. Run your own instance the way you'd self-host a personal finance tool — your career data stays on your own server. If you expose it to the internet, an optional Basic Auth gate can be turned on via environment variables (off by default).
concept.freeTextTitle: Free-text skills, not a fixed taxonomy
concept.freeTextBody: Skills are stored as the natural language the LLM extracts from your activity, or that you type directly — not normalized IDs from a predefined list.
concept.llmOptionalBody: Extracting skills from free text, and the three AI Career Support features (Career Consult, growth guidance, job-posting gap check), are the only things that call an LLM. Everything else — adding or editing a skill by hand, career path goals, Vision, Self Feedback, Self PR, generating a resume/rirekisho, backup and restore — works fully with no LLM configured at all.
concept.pluggableLlmBody: When a feature does call one, it talks to any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint — a cloud API or a local Ollama server. Configured from Settings, not hardcoded.
concept.evidenceNotAssessmentBody: Skills mostly come from things you already have (a resume, a certificate, a project description) rather than from filling out a skill matrix from memory. The one exception is proficiency (1-5) on each skill — a deliberate, self-reported field, added so you can see skill level at a glance.

ai.title: AI Career Support
ai.subtitle: The features here call an LLM. Everything else in this app — including generating your resume — works without one.
ai.consultHint: Chat with an AI career consultant grounded in your actual skills, activity, education, work history, Self PR, Vision, and career path goals — not generic advice.
ai.consultCustomInstructionsHint: Added to the base system prompt — tone, focus areas, anything you want it to always keep in mind. Can't change what data it's grounded in, or make it skip asking when it doesn't know something.
ai.consultCustomInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Be blunt and direct. Focus especially on leadership growth.
ai.consultPageHint: This conversation sees your full career data (see the Career Consult card on AI Integration for what that includes).
ai.consultPlaceholder: Ask about your career, skills, or next steps…
ai.consultConfirmDelete: Delete this entire conversation? This can't be undone.
ai.guidanceHint: For each career path goal you've written on the Dashboard, the LLM suggests what to develop next given your current skills.
ai.guidanceButton: See how to grow toward these goals
ai.guidanceNeedsGoal: Write at least one goal on the Dashboard first.
ai.gapCheckHint: Paste a job posting to see how it lines up against your current skills.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, LLM connection, data management, and about this app.
settings.llmSubtitle: Configure the LLM connection. Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint works — cloud API or local Ollama.
settings.skillExtractionHint: Automatically extract skills from Quick update, Activity, and Profile text using the LLM. Turn off to save instantly instead of waiting on the LLM — certification image extraction is unaffected either way.
settings.backupHint: Download all of your career data (activity, skills, profile, goals — with history, links, self PR history, resume history) as a single JSON file. Your LLM connection settings are not included.
settings.importHint: Upload a backup JSON file (from this app's own backup download) to restore its records. This adds records — it does not delete or replace anything already here.
settings.confirmImport: Import this file's records into your data? This cannot be undone from the UI.
settings.sampleHint: Load a small fictional career history (skills, employment, projects, activity) so you can see what a populated app looks like. Adds records — safe to run on an empty install, but will mix in with any real data you've already added.
settings.confirmLoadSample: Load the bundled sample data into your app now?
settings.confirmResetSample: Remove everything that sample data loaded (in any load so far)? Anything you've added yourself is left untouched.
settings.resetAllHint: Wipes everything — skills, activity, profile, resumes, self PR, career goals/vision, and the LLM connection settings — back to a fresh install. This cannot be undone; consider downloading a backup first.
settings.confirmResetAll: This permanently deletes ALL of your data, including your own — not just sample data — and the LLM connection settings. This cannot be undone. Continue?
settings.resetAllTypeMismatch: Type RESET (all caps) exactly to confirm.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.body: skillgrowth is open source (MIT). Found a bug, have an idea, or want to improve something yourself? Issues and pull requests are both very welcome.
